name: Access Scope Finding Source
description: The source role of the Network Access Analyzer compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): the first component of a finding's path, in SequenceNumber order -> the finding, the middle node. A role name, the official exception to <ACTION>_<OBJECT>. The sources are the types the Network Access Analyzer guide says a finding's path can start or end at, each named by its resource id or ARN. The finding retires with this end (COMPOUND_EDGE retires_with). Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/network_insights.py (aws-core-tap#212, #248).
